summary_en: Appirits to acquire 100% of Fullbalance Inc. (EC site construction and operation via Shopify platform) via board resolution dated 2026-06-29. Fullbalance shareholders: Minoru Kakuma 40%, Mao Harada 30%, Kensuke Nakanishi 30%. Fullbalance FY3/25 sales ¥269.9M, operating profit ¥18.0M. Post-acquisition, Fullbalance CEO to remain in management.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of shares in Fullbalance Inc. (complete subsidiary)
translation_en_brief:
On 26 June 2026, Appirits Inc. (TSE Standard, ticker 4174) resolved by board resolution and written consent under Companies Act Article 370 and the company's bylaws to acquire all shares of Fullbalance Inc., establishing it as a wholly owned subsidiary. Post-acquisition, Fullbalance's CEO will continue to be involved in the company's management.

Fullbalance (founded January 2004, Tokyo) operates an 'EC concierge' model providing end-to-end support for e-commerce site design, construction, operation, marketing and sales growth via the Shopify platform. The company holds ~200 site construction projects, serves entertainment-sector fan communities and major clients (Bookoff Group Holdings, Suntory Holdings), and is certified as a Shopify Platinum Partner (2024 Partner of the Year). Revenue FY3/25 reached ¥269.9M with operating profit of ¥18.0M, supported by a hybrid revenue model combining monthly service contracts and initial construction. Current shareholders: Minoru Kakuma (board chair) 40%, Mao Harada (CEO) 30%, Kensuke Nakanishi 30%.

Appirits cited strategic rationale: Fullbalance's EC capabilities and fan-community expertise align with Appirits' Web Solutions and Entertainment & Game divisions, offering synergies in the expanding e-commerce market. The acquisition also secures high-calibre engineering and design talent and enterprise customer relationships to support Appirits Group expansion.
